MD 4AM (after PX) 2PH 2FD. As above, unit appear like a former PX-rich intrusive (dolerite or pyroxenite). Former stubby pyroxene crystals are ductilely deformed in places, suggesting high-temperature deformation. Deformation is generally localised to cm-scale shear bands, with a massive appearance comprising the overall dominant texture. Unit hosts ~1-2% <1cm wide partly resorbed qtz-cb veins which are crosscut and offset by late-stage brittle NW-trending faults. Sulphides are essentially absent.

*AU present* "MD" 4AM (after PX) 2PH 2FD. As above, except that two occurrences of gold occur in partly-resorbed qtz-cb veins at 36.25 and 36.31m. The gold at 36.25m occurs in a NW-trending healed mm-scale fault zone / fault plane. The gold at 36.31m occurs within a subhorizontal vein which is crosscut by the fault which hosts the gold at 36.25m. NOTE: Both gold occurences sits within the non-sampled half of the core, therefore the assay result may be negligible.
